name: Love In The Abyss
source:
A story about two brothers... They lived a happy life until their parents died in an accident. Due to this, Chris (the protagonist) and Jack (his brother) lived with their grandparents.

However, this didn't last long, as their grandparents both died as well.

With this, Jack and Chris lived together, helped each other, and learned together... until suddenly, they met a goddess who sends them on a journey to destroy all the evil in the Abyss.

This includes the King of Hell: Lucy...

[From [url=https://itsmedevroland.itch.io/love-in-the-abyss]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个关于两兄弟的故事……他们过着幸福的生活，直到父母因事故去世。因此，克里斯（主角）和杰克（他的兄弟）和他们的祖父母住在一起。

然而，这种情况并没有持续多久，他们的祖父母也相继去世。

就这样，杰克和克里斯一起生活，互相帮助，一起学习……直到突然，他们遇到了一位女神，女神送他们踏上毁灭深渊一切邪恶的旅程。

其中包括地狱之王：露西……

[来自[url=https://itsmedevroland.itch.io/love-in-the-abyss]itch.io[/url]]
